violations.issue: OtelReceiver.start() is awaited (not a task) inside the TaskGroup. When the TaskGroup exits, otel_receiver.stop() is never invoked. The daemon thread makes this safe at process exit, but graceful shutdown is lost. Acceptable for best-effort — not a blocker.

review_notes: All 6 prior review violations fixed: OtelReceiver wired into main.py, otel_port threaded through graph→TddNode→dispatch, BP_LOG_LEVEL replaces LOG_LEVEL, OTEL SDK packages in Dockerfile.sandbox, dead _get_span_type loop removed, README updated.
All 25 relevant unit tests pass (5 OTEL receiver + 12 dispatch + 8 agent_config). Test_dispatch_injects_otel_env_var and test_to_opencode_json_otel_enabled confirm OTEL wiring in dispatch and config.
1 integration test fails (test_dispatch_say_hello_against_real_sandbox) — pre-existing Docker/gVisor infrastructure issue, not caused by OTEL changes.
OtelReceiver is a good deep module: 3 public methods, all OTLP parsing and filtering hidden inside. Tests exercise through real HTTP — integration-style at the unit level.
No spec violations. All AC-06 and AC-07 requirements met at code level. README documents BP_LOG_LEVEL, BP_OTEL_PORT, and the observability pipeline.
Graceful shutdown note is minor (daemon thread) and consistent with the ticket's best-effort requirement.
